country.name: Denmark
country.pr: 8 years of legal residence in general; reducible to 4 years if you pass the Danish PD3 test, work full-time, are self-sufficient and meet active-citizenship conditions.
country.citizenship: Granted by an Act of the Danish Parliament after conditions are met; the exact timeline was not verified this session. Denmark allows dual citizenship (general knowledge).
country.pro: High pay and strong work-life balance (general knowledge).
country.con: One of the strictest immigration regimes in Europe (general knowledge).
